scenarioDescriptions.Cook_with_Pip: Cook with Pip household recipe search with the Bicol Express result visible.
scenarioDescriptions.Cook_Now: Cook Now mode is selected and its matching recipe is visible.
scenarioDescriptions.Recipe_Detail_Instructions: The selected recipe detail shows its first readable instruction step.
scenarioDescriptions.Pip_Chat_Conversation: A synthetic chat reply and validated household recipe card are visible.
scenarioDescriptions.Pip_Chat_Shopping_Preview_Action: A synthetic chat shopping action is visible before opening the existing review flow.
scenarioDescriptions.Pip_Chat_Recipe_Context: Pip Chat identifies the household recipe that opened the conversation.
scenarioDescriptions.Pip_Chat_Product_Context: Pip Chat identifies the household product that opened the conversation.
scenarioDescriptions.Pip_Chat_Consent_Controls: Chat consent is enabled separately from allergy sharing, which is shown enabled in the synthetic fixture.
scenarioDescriptions.Pip_Chat_Dark_Large_Text: Pip Chat consent controls remain readable in dark mode at accessibility text size.
scenarioDescriptions.My_Recipes_Search_Scrolled: Filtered household recipes remain visible after dismissing the search keyboard.
scenarioDescriptions.Recipe_Detail_Large_Text_Summary_Filipin: A long Filipino recipe summary remains readable at accessibility text size.
scenarioDescriptions.Shopping_Preview_Revision_Details_Large_: Expanded shopping and pantry revisions remain readable at accessibility text size.
scenarioDescriptions.Staging_Authenticated_Home: The synthetic staging account reaches its authenticated household dashboard.
scenarioDescriptions.Staging_Logged_Out: The staging account remains logged out after app relaunch.
scenarioDescriptions.Staging_Relaunch_Recovery: The authenticated synthetic staging session restores its loaded pantry after relaunch.
scenarioDescriptions.Staging_Relogin_Relaunch_Recovery: After a new synthetic staging login and relaunch, the fixture product is visible in Inventory.
